raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: S3 bucket for application user uploads with secure defaults and access controls.

Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional. Specify to create the bucket with a custom name. Leave blank to auto-generate.
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty.
  AllowedCORSOrigins:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "https://example.com"
    Description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g., https://app.example.com,https://admin.example.com).

Conditions:
  HasBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, ""]]

Resources:
  UploadsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting S3 user uploads
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowUseOfKeyViaS3InThisAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
  UploadsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/s3-uploads-${AWS::StackName}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UploadsKmsKey

  UploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [HasBucketName, !Ref BucketName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref UploadsKmsKey
      CorsConfiguration:
        CorsRules:
          - AllowedOrigins: !Ref AllowedCORSOrigins
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - PUT
              - POST
              - HEAD
            AllowedHeaders:
              - "*"
            ExposedHeaders:
              - ETag
            MaxAge: 3000
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            Filter: {}
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !If [HasBucketName, !Ref BucketName, !Sub "s3-uploads-${AWS::StackName}"]
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: UserUploads

  UploadsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UploadsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UploadsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: DenyPublicAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UploadsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: "Anonymous"
          - Sid: EnforceKmsEncryptionWhenSpecified
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
              Null:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: "false"
          - Sid: EnforceSpecificKmsKeyWhenSpecified
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id:
                  - !GetAtt UploadsKmsKey.Arn
                  - !Ref UploadsKmsKey
                  - !Sub
                    - "arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AliasName}"
                    - { AliasName: !Ref UploadsKmsAlias }
                  - !Ref UploadsKmsAlias
              Null:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id: "false"

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for user uploads
    Value: !Ref UploadsBucket
  BucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for user uploads
    Value: !GetAtt UploadsBucket.Arn
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for encrypting uploads
    Value: !GetAtt UploadsKmsKey.Arn
  KmsAliasName:
    Description: Alias name of the KMS key
    Value: !Ref UploadsKmsAlias
